about: ChimpBench parameter registry (docs/realism-design.md §4): every behavioral, ecological and demographic constant the simulation reads, with its plausible range, hard limits, evidence and sources. Human-edited, sorted by id. scripts/gen-params.ts validates it and writes src/sim/params.gen.ts. Planned entries document parameter constraints (P-*) whose mechanisms arrive in later stages.

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): photoreceptor activation rate at I0 (alpha_0; alpha = alpha_0 (I / I0)^p). Human circadian pacemaker model (forger1999, equations and values as in crodelle2023; research.md E.22) [H] for humans; no chimpanzee value exists, so assumed (cross-species).

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): amplitude of the circadian modulation of both thresholds (a; H = H0 + a C, C the oscillator's x). Two-process model standard value (daan1984 via skeldonDijk2025) [H] for humans; cross-species, assumed. Range: 0.07 in skeldonDijk2025's alternative simulations.

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): photoreceptor recovery rate (beta). Human circadian pacemaker model (forger1999, equations and values as in crodelle2023; research.md E.22) [H] for humans; no chimpanzee value exists, so assumed (cross-species).

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): length of the entrainment run that sets an animal's oscillator at its first tick with the switch on (floor light while awake, eyes closed while asleep, clear sky). Design: only the initial state; the 30-day burn-in removes what is left of it.

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): scaling of the light drive B = G (1 - n) alpha (G). Human circadian pacemaker model (forger1999, equations and values as in crodelle2023; research.md E.22) [H] for humans; no chimpanzee value exists, so assumed (cross-species). 37 in the seventh-order variant (papatsimpa2021).

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): mean lower (waking) threshold of sleep pressure, H0-. Two-process model standard value (daan1984 via skeldonDijk2025) [H] for humans; cross-species, assumed.

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): mean upper (sleep-onset) threshold of sleep pressure, H0+. Two-process model standard value (daan1984, as given in skeldonDijk2025; research.md E.22) [H] for humans; cross-species, assumed. Range: 0.75 in skeldonDijk2025's alternative simulations.

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): reference illuminance of the light-activation rate (I0). Human circadian pacemaker model (forger1999, equations and values as in crodelle2023; research.md E.22) [H] for humans; no chimpanzee value exists, so assumed (cross-species).

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): effect of the light drive on the oscillator's period (k). Human circadian pacemaker model (forger1999, equations and values as in crodelle2023; research.md E.22) [H] for humans; no chimpanzee value exists, so assumed (cross-species).

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): stiffness of the van der Pol oscillator (mu). Human circadian pacemaker model (forger1999, equations and values as in crodelle2023; research.md E.22) [H] for humans; no chimpanzee value exists, so assumed (cross-species). Range: 0.13 in the seventh-order variant (papatsimpa2021).

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): exponent of the light-activation rate (p). Human circadian pacemaker model (forger1999, equations and values as in crodelle2023; research.md E.22) [H] for humans; no chimpanzee value exists, so assumed (cross-species). 0.6 in Kronauer et al. 1999 (as noted by the CSO model paper, PMC9552883).

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): circadian sensitivity modulator of the light drive, (1 - s x)(1 - s x_c). Human circadian pacemaker model (forger1999, equations and values as in crodelle2023; research.md E.22) [H] for humans; no chimpanzee value exists, so assumed (cross-species).

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): intrinsic period of the oscillator (tau_x). Human circadian pacemaker model (forger1999, equations and values as in crodelle2023; research.md E.22) [H] for humans; no chimpanzee value exists, so assumed (cross-species). Human intrinsic period 24.18 h (czeisler1999); range: rhesus macaques free-run at 23.4-25.1 h in dim constant light (masudaZhdanova2010).

Mean fullness 0.354. 0 = off, every crown full at peak (the C7a model). Pre-registered field value 11.9; off by default after the C7b direction check (c7b-prereg addendum): with unlimited fallback foods, smaller crops moved feeding to the ground (fruit share 0.42) and parties apart.

Stage C7b (field; c7b-prereg 3.2): the least fullness of a fruiting crown at its peak, so the smallest crop capacity (~0.2) still reaches the feeding threshold (0.06, perception.ts) and every fruiting crown counts as fruiting. Design. Unused while cropFullExp is 0. Read only when cropFullExp > 0 (off by default since the C7b direction check).

Stage C7a (field): a patch's crop capacity scales with (crown radius / species mean)^this, renormalized so each species' mean is unchanged; 2 = crown area (allometric design assumption). Stage E2c switch (docs/staging/e2c-prereg.md): darkness acts through its physical consequences instead of the nest's darkness weight. The light at the animal's height (sky illuminance from the sun's altitude, skyLuxSun, under the E2a cloud attenuation and canopy profile) sets its visual acuity relative to full daylight (shlaer1937 fit, sightAcuity*); feeding intake, the sight radius and the walking pace (walkDarkPace) follow it, and trips are valued with the light expected on arrival. The nest's value becomes resting plus sleep pressure (rhythmSleepW x S x (1 - daylight)); rhythmDarkW is no longer read, resting outside a nest no longer carries the sleep term (only a nest lets an animal sleep), and an animal in its own finished nest is not offered rest separately (resting there is staying in the nest). Leopards are absent from Kibale (wood2017), so no predation term. Iteration 2: a night or dusk menu left with one option is that option (rg.ts). Result: a recorded null (night activity of juveniles outside the night menu, a 12.3-12.5 h active day, T-RHY-3 overshoot; e2c-prereg §8-9). Needs rhythmSleep; no effect otherwise. 0 = E2a/E2b, bit-identical. Ablation switch.

Stomach plus small intestine as a share of gut volume in chimpanzees: stomach 17-20% and small intestine 23-28% (Milton 1987 table, seen only as cited by a secondary web page); apes hold more than 45% of gut volume in the colon (milton1999, full text). The rest is the hindgut (caecum and colon).

Volume of the digestive tract: 3,329 mL in a captive chimpanzee (derived from nakamura2017, abstract: 489.4 cm3 of seeds = 14.7% of the previously reported capacity; the original measurement, probably Chivers & Hladik 1980, was not read), divided by an assumed reference mass of 40 kg (range 30-55 kg: 111-60 mL/kg); isometric scaling with body mass assumed.

Mean retention time of indigestible markers through the whole tract: 38 h on a 34% NDF diet and 48 h on 14% NDF in captive chimpanzees (miltonDemment1988; the 38 h seen only in a search snippet, the 48 h confirmed by milton1999, full text: 2.0 d). The hindgut passes residue with a time constant of this minus ledgerGutEmptyH. Range: about 31 h (lambert2002, secondary) to 48 h.

The fibre credit inside the field's metabolisable-energy formula (4 x sugars and protein + 9 x lipid + 1.6 x NDF; uwimbabazi2019, after Conklin-Brittain et al. 2006). Used only to split a food's formula energy (the kcal/min inputs) into its non-fibre part and its fibre; the energy fibre actually yields is digestaFermentKcalPerG x digestaNdfDigestibility. The credit equals 3 kcal/g x 0.53 (derived; masi2015 states the structure 3 kcal/g x digestion coefficient).

Share of fibre (NDF) fermented: 0.449 in captive western gorillas on a highly fibrous diet (remisDierenfeld2004, as used by masi2015, full text). Cross-species: no chimpanzee value was read; the chimpanzee formula credit implies 0.53 (1.6 / 3, derived); captive orangutans 0.45-0.745 by fibre source (schmidt2005, abstract); chimpanzee fibre digestibility falls as dietary fibre rises (miltonDemment1988, abstract) and wild fruit (41.5% NDF) is more fibrous than either chimpanzee trial diet (14%, 34%).

Stage E4a: the stress recovery rate is (1/endoStressTauH) × (1 + this × affiliation). Direction verified (docs/research.md, Track E sources) (wittig2016 [H], full text: glucocorticoids 23% lower with a bond partner in every context); the route through the affiliation state and the size are assumed (design assumption).

Stage E4a: affiliation rises by this × (1 − affiliation) at a reconciliation (both) and a consolation (both). Direction verified (docs/research.md, Track E sources) (preis2018 [M], abstract: oxytocin higher after reconciliation and bystander affiliation than after aggression alone); the size is a design assumption.

Stage E4a: affiliation rises by this × (1 − affiliation) in giver and receiver when food is shared. Direction verified (docs/research.md, Track E sources) (wittig2014 [M], abstract only, n not given: oxytocin higher after food sharing than after grooming, whatever the bond); the size is a design assumption.
Stage E4a: time constant of the affiliation state (oxytocin-like). assumed (no verified time scale for urinary oxytocin: docs/research.md, Track E sources, gap 8).

Stage E4a: target of an adult male's competitive arousal per unit swelling of the most swollen parous, unrelated female of his community in view. Direction verified (docs/research.md, Track E sources) (sobolewski2013 [M], abstract: testosterone above baseline with parous oestrous females, not nulliparous ones); the size is a design assumption. Parous = 15 y or over, or an amenorrhoea set by a birth (design proxy).

Stage E4a: target of an adult male's competitive arousal per unit rank closeness (1 − |ΔElo| ÷ escalateEloGap) of the closest-rank adult male in view. assumed (challenge hypothesis; mullerWrangham2004b seen only as cited).
Stage E4a: time constant of competitive arousal (testosterone-like). assumed (no verified constant; labelled steroid peaks in urine within 5.5 h, bahr2000 [M], one captive male).
Stage E4a: an adult male's arousal rises by this × (1 − arousal) when he wins a decided conflict. assumed (winner effect; no wild chimpanzee source).

Stage E4a switch (docs/staging/e4a-prereg.md): no escalation impulse is drawn (escalateImpulseBase and escalateImpulseAggr are not read, world.rng is not touched). An escalated attack on a close-rank adult male is offered whenever its preconditions hold, scored endoEscalateScore × arousal × ½(aggression + tension toward him) × (1 − stress) × (1 − affiliation × bond). Needs endoStates 1: it counts as off (the impulse dice) unless endoStates is 1 (endocrine.ts endoOn; E4b review fix). 0 = the impulse dice. Ablation switch.
Stage E4a moved literal: the score of the escalated attack opened by an escalation impulse (unchanged at endoEscalate 0). With endoEscalate 1 it is the ceiling the states scale down.

Stage E4b switch (docs/staging/e4b-prereg.md): a fast arousal state (catecholamine-like) runs, chimp.sim.fast with chimp.sim.fastAt, kicked at a daytime storm onset (endoFastStormKick) and by aggression received (endoFastThreatKick), decaying with endoFastTauMin. With endoRainDisplay the rain display is scored from it (rainDisplayScore × min(1, fast × (1 + arousal)) × boldness, for endoFastSpanTau time constants after the onset) instead of from the slow arousal. Needs endoStates 1: it counts as off unless endoStates is 1 (endocrine.ts endoOn). 0 = E4a, bit-identical. Ablation switch.

Stage E4b switch (docs/staging/e4b-prereg.md): after a lost conflict the redirected charge is scored fast × (redirectBase + redirectAggrW × aggression + redirectStressW × stress + redirectTensionW × tension) minus the guardian deterrent, offered until the loser next aggresses, for endoFastSpanTau time constants of the fast state; E4a iteration 1's rule (the defeat considered once, at the first choice) is dropped. Needs endoStates, endoRedirect and endoFast 1: it counts as off otherwise (endocrine.ts endoOn). 0 = E4a's redirect. Ablation switch.

Stage E4b: an option the fast state scores (rain display, redirected charge) stays on offer for this many of its time constants after the event, when the state is below 5% of a kick (design), so it is not left on the menu at a score of nearly 0.

Stage E4b: the fast arousal of every awake individual rises by this × (1 − fast) at a daytime storm onset. Direction: sudden loud sound drives rhythmic display-like movement, more in males (hattoriTomonaga2020 [M], captive; docs/research.md E.15); the size is a design assumption (one of the strongest acute stimuli, short of saturating the state), set before any run and not tuned.

Stage E4b: time constant of the fast arousal state. Bounded below by plasma catecholamine clearance (half-lives about 1–2.5 min; secondary sources only, not verified) and above by post-conflict anxiety in captive chimpanzees, raised for the entire 10-min post-conflict window (fraser2008 [M], docs/research.md E.15): at 5 min a kick is still 14% at 10 min. The value inside the bounds is a design assumption.

Stage E4b: the fast arousal rises by this × (1 − fast) when the animal is charged or attacked, loses a decided conflict, or is gang-attacked. Direction: heart rate rises at a dominant's approach (aureli1999 [L], rhesus, 2 females); victims' anxiety stays raised after a conflict (fraser2008 [M], captive chimpanzees; docs/research.md E.15). The size is a design assumption, equal to the storm kick, set before any run.

Stage E4b fix of E4a (docs/staging/e4b-prereg.md §1): a stranger call heard after this long without one starts a new hearing episode, and only the start of an episode kicks the stress load (endoStressStrangerW). Before the fix every slow step with a call heard kicked it again while a chorus or counter-calling went on. Design: the window in which observe() still reports a heard chorus (15 min). Read only while endoStates is 1.

Stage E4a: the simulation keeps no parity record. A female counts as parous from this age, or once a birth has set her amenorrhoea (first births come at about 14–15.5 y in Kibale, as in reproduction.ts). Used only for the arousal driver endoArousalOestrusW (testosterone responds to parous oestrous females, not nulliparous ones; sobolewski2013 in docs/research.md (Track E sources)).

Stage E4a switch (docs/staging/e4a-prereg.md): no rain-display roll (rainDisplayP is not read, world.rng is not touched). At a daytime storm onset every adult male is offered the display for impulseDurationH, once, scored rainDisplayScore × arousal × boldness. Needs endoStates 1: it counts as off (the 12% roll) unless endoStates is 1 (endocrine.ts endoOn; E4b review fix). 0 = the 12% roll. Ablation switch.

Stage E4a switch (docs/staging/e4a-prereg.md): no redirect roll (redirectBaseP and redirectAggrP are not read, world.rng is not touched). Every lost conflict is noted, and the defeat is considered once, at the loser's first choice after it, whatever he chooses (iteration 1; execution.ts startAction clears it; the option stays bounded by endoStressTauH and by his next own aggression): a charge at a dominated, unrelated bystander scored stress × (redirectBase + redirectAggrW × aggression + redirectTensionW × tension + redirectStressW), minus the guardian deterrent. Needs endoStates 1: it counts as off (the dice) unless endoStates is 1 (endocrine.ts endoOn; E4b review fix). 0 = the priming dice and the 6-minute window. Ablation switch.

Stage E4a switch (docs/staging/e4a-prereg.md): three slow internal states run. chimp.stress becomes the stress load (target from energy deficit and strangers, kicks at aggression, recovery sped by affiliation, time constant endoStressTauH) in place of the fixed relaxation stressRelaxPerH; chimp.sim.arousal (adult males) and chimp.sim.affil are created. 0 = today's model, bit-identical. Ablation switch.

Stage E4a: stress rises by this × (1 − stress) when the animal starts a charge or an attack, or is the target of one. Direction verified (docs/research.md, Track E sources) (wittig2015 [H], full text: glucocorticoids rise after a single aggressive interaction in aggressor and victim, 112% against 85% after rest, 9 males); the size is a design assumption.

Milk energy a mother can make per day per kg^0.75 of her mass: the human 501 kcal/day (749 g/day x 2.8 kJ/g, Butte & King 2005) at 60 kg; about 307 kcal/day at 31.3 kg. Milk energy output scales with maternal mass^0.74 +- 0.05 across 47 mammal species (Riek 2021, abstract); the coefficient is the human one and no chimpanzee milk yield exists. A value above about 1,000 removes the limit (iteration 1). (E1 iteration 2: without it a larger infant simply drank more.) Pending e-sources (not yet in docs/research.md).

Infants share the mother's nest until weaning (khayer2025 [M]); night suckling: captive newborns (mizuno2006 [L]) and the human analogy. With it, ledgerMilkStoreH can take its sourced value (11 h, kent1999). 0 = milk only through the day nurse act (E1).

Stage E1f (docs/staging/e1f-prereg.md §2.1), with energyLedger 1: 1 = one nursing rule. A day nursing bout is worth the milk it can deliver per unit of time committed to it, as a share of the full suckling rate, the milk-ejection latency (ledgerLetDownS) included: the whole nurse score x E / (E + suckling rate x latency), with E = min(the gland store plus what is made while it drains, the milk the infant's foregut can take; digesta-consistent units). In the act no milk flows for the first ledgerLetDownS of contact, and the bout ends when a tick delivers less than the full flow (gland or gut) or at the existing hunger end. Supersedes ledgerNurseByMilk (E1d) and the nursing term of ledgerDrive (E1e), which are not read while it is 1 and keep their meaning while it is 0. The night rule (ledgerNightNurse) is unchanged. 0 = today's routes.

No new number. Non-nutritive (comfort) suckling, documented in the field (badescu2017, badescu2022, matsumoto2017), is not modelled. 0 = the score ignores the gland and the bout lasts while the infant is hungry (E1, E1c).

Pending e-sources (not yet in docs/research.md).

Stage E2d (docs/staging/e2d-prereg.md, rhythmCircadian): process C of the two-process model as physiology. Each animal carries an oscillator (circadian.ts; forger1999) entrained by the light at its eyes (the E2c sky model x the E2a canopy share at its height, 0 while asleep), and a sleep latch: sleep starts when sleep pressure S reaches the upper threshold circHUpper + circAmp x C and ends at the lower circHLower + circAmp x C (daan1984 via skeldonDijk2025), C the oscillator's core-temperature variable. Only sleep (latch on, in its own finished nest or its mother's) discharges S; an asleep animal makes no decision until it wakes. The nest is worth the rest score without its fatigue term plus rhythmSleepW x felt sleepiness q (1 while the latch is on, else the position of S between the thresholds); rest outside a nest carries no sleep term; a new nest is offered under E2a's light gate (daylight < 1; iteration 2, after day nests took a third of the daytime when it was offered at any light). rhythmDarkW and the light masking S x (1 - daylight) are not read. A night or dusk menu with one option is that option. Result: a recorded null (e2d-prereg §8-9): sleep falls 97-102 min after sunset to 123-128 min before sunrise (8.2 h) and nobody leaves a nest during it, but nothing holds the two hours awake before dawn (adults wait only for the night menu; juveniles out 4-5% of the night). Needs rhythmSleep; no effect otherwise. 0 = E2a/E2b/E2c, bit-identical. Ablation switch.

Travel to a remembered tree: score falls by 1 per this many metres. Travel-cost scale (score falls by 1 per this many metres). Compressed literal before C5a; field value set for real distances between food patches (design, tuned to T-ACT-2 and T-RNG-4 in stage C5a). Field value tuned in C5a against T-ACT-2 and T-RNG-4 (with the cohesion weights); both targets are labelled tuned (C5a review). Stage C7a: field value 60,000 m, fitted against the two C12 statistics declared fitted (path per hour, Taï; same-day displacement, Ngogo) on proof seeds 48 and 7 (probes 2,000 / 6,000 / 20,000 / 60,000 m: 101 / 148 / 186 / 214 m/h, 0.20 / 0.29 / 0.31 / 0.34 km); the knob saturates below the field values. Distance then barely matters within a range, as field chimpanzees skip the nearest productive tree 70% of the time (normand2009). Stage C7c (c7b-prereg 6.3): field value derived from travel energetics, L = daily energy / (memTravelHungerW x cost of walking a metre) = 2,500 kcal (uwimbabazi2019; one hunger unit is about a day's intake) / (1.25 x 0.0318 kcal/m) = 62,900 m, with the net cost of transport 10.7 M^-0.316 J/kg/m (taylor1982) at M = 40 kg (design; 33-45 kg gives 58-72 km), inside the measured chimpanzee range (sockol2007). Walking 1 km costs ~1% of a day's energy: energetics justify an almost flat distance cost; the C7a fit (60,000 m) sits on it by coincidence. Compressed keeps its literal (60 m).
